name: Hi-Tech Flow Solutions Limited
industry: Steel Pipes & Infrastructure / Helical Submerged Arc Welded (HSAW) Pipes
description: We provide flow solution products having varied applications by manufacturing and supplying Helical Submerged Arc Welded (HSAW) pipes across 17 states and 2 union territories in India, through our manufacturing facilities at Sanand, Gujarat and Nagpur, Maharashtra. We operate on a business-to-business model catering primarily to EPC contractors executing large-scale water-transmission pipelines, irrigation networks, and urban infrastructure projects.

objects.purpose: Funding the proposed expansion by setting up API-grade HSAW pipe manufacturing unit along with a 3LPE coating unit within our existing Nagpur Facility
Repayment or pre-payment, in part or full of certain borrowings availed by our Company from banks

top_risks: We primarily derive our revenue from the sale of HSAW pipes to EPC contractors engaged in Government-funded water transmission and urban infrastructure projects (72.14% in Fiscal 2026), making us vulnerable to delays, disruptions, or funding constraints in these projects.

Our manufacturing operations are concentrated in Gujarat and Maharashtra, and a significant portion of our revenue is derived from Maharashtra, Gujarat, and West Bengal, exposing us to region-specific risks.

We depend on a limited number of domestic suppliers for the procurement of our key raw materials, with our top five suppliers accounting for 90.75% of total purchase cost in Fiscal 2026 without long-term agreements.
